newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM confirms full-year profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: KLM confirms full-year profit forecast.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines said on Tuesday it maintained its earlier forecast that full-year net profits before provisions for 1996/97 would be some 150 million guilders lower than that of the previous year.

"Based on the current indications of a slight upturn in the market situation...we confirm our earlier expectation that the net result after tax for full-year 1996/97 before provision for restructuring ...will be around 150 million guilders lower than in 1995/96," KLM said in a statement.
